# Event Register for TEIPod Project

* Implementation of custom Events register for TEIPod TEI Publisher project.
* Based on and expanded from the default code generated by the TEI Publisher 10
entity registers profile.
* For the files `config.json`, `modules/config.xqm`, and `collection.xconf`
only the sections specific to the Events register are included.
* The body of `events.xml` is expected to have the following structure:

```
<standOff>
    <listEvent>
        <event>...</event>
    </listEvent>
</standOff>
```

### `<event>` element structure

#### Attributes:

* One or more attributes indicating the date when the event occurred. 
    * Attributes `@when`, `@notBefore`, `@notAfter`, and `@when-custom` are allowed
    * Only events with `@when` are included in the timeline component
* A `@xml:id` identifier unique within the project
* A `@source` reference to the episode in which the event occurs or is mentioned
    * The value should reference an episode's `@xml:id`

#### Child elements

* A `<desc>` element describing the event
* A `<note>` element specifying the date of the event in the format to be shown in the user interface

#### Examples

```
<event when="1998-11-22" xml:id="MAG2-19981122" source="#MAG2">
    <desc>MAG 2 statement given</desc>
    <note>22nd November 1998</note>
</event>
```

```
<event notBefore="1990" notAfter="1999" xml:id="MAG2-90s" source="#MAG2>
    <desc>Events from the MAG 2 statement</desc>
    <note>1990s</note>
</event>
```
